strings.en: I shall do what must be done now!
Please watch over me, Lord Raidy!
Behold the power of the Fairlion!
I'll be taking the first move!
I cannot afford to lose here!
Interfere, and I shan't hold back!
For the people's sake, for now...!
Fighting for peace.../　I understand the contradiction!
Time for some Vigor... er, I mean,/　let's go with some Spirit!
I'll beat you senseless... er, I mean,/　I shall teach you a lesson!
Blast thr... I mean, I shall fire!
I'll kick your... er, I shall charge!
Let's throw down... er, a fair duel!
I can hardly fathom your way of thinking!
Pride and arrogance are not the same thing!
Jua-Mu, I shall be your opponent!
Al-Van, you shall face me as well!
Knight of the Fury... I shall fight fair and square!
The green Raftclans... a formidable foe indeed...!
Do you not understand the feelings/　of Her Highness, Princess Shana-Mia?!
That unit is an ill omen...!
That black unit... I have a bad feeling...!
Disguising your ambition with convenient words...!/　Have you no shame?!
Gu-Landon!/　You lack the caliber to lead the people!
I shall defeat the shadow that threatens the people!
Gomoudokka Golaikunru.../　Is that the President?
I must be wary of that scythe!
I hardly expected you to let me pass quietly!
I haven't a single drop of blood/　to offer you!
How many have been sacrificed/　because of your research...!
I won't let you have the Cross Gate, Herluga!
For what purpose are you/　gathering the Kaana?!
Monster or not, that form is quite beyond a joke!
A clown should make others laugh, not laugh himself!
I shan't lose to a puppet!
Controlling that machine will do you no good!
I shall slay the wicked dragon!
Skull Knight! I shall be your opponent!
Skeleton or knight--/　I do wish you'd make up your mind...!
Just like a ghost from a fairy tale...
For such a thing to emerge/　from the Cross Gate...!
For the sake of many people... I will strike down XN-L!
I know how to fight that machine!
No matter how often you appear,/　the result is the same!
I shan't lose to a Zovorg unit!
No matter how many times/　you come to Earth!
Spreading war about is utterly unforgivable!
I shan't let you pass here!
I know where to aim on that ship!
If it's something that brings chaos to Earth...!
I shall be your opponent, Thick Cylinder!
I'll chop off that splendid horn of yours.../　Er, I shall sever it for you!
No mercy for those who threaten this world!
If we leave that be,/　many people will suffer...!
I shan't flinch, even against a ghost!
We must defeat the Lamaris at once...!
I cannot leave the Lamaris Kaana be!
For the Lamaris to grow so large...!
How many Lamaris are in that.../　I'd rather not imagine...!
I can't have the Lamaris multiplying!
Unless we deal with the Ares Geist,/　the Lamaris will...!
I won't be fooled by appearances!
That dog won't fly.../　I mean, that dog won't hunt!
I'll turn this around from here!
Allow me to return the favor!
I cannot back down/　at this point!
I'm not some ornament who merely watches!
I-I'm afraid I must retire here...
Ugh...!/　I mustn't hold everyone back...!
I-I won't end in a place like this!
Am I being overwhelmed by Jua-Mu's ferocity...?!
Th-The Emperor Unit's power is overwhelming...!
Th-That power is too much for you!
I-I'll be the one laughing last, Debudedabide!
I-I'll prove that even a fairy/　can defeat a dragon...!
I-I refuse to join the skeletons!
This is no time to be afraid of the Lamaris...!
How dare you harm my precious Fairlion!
I-it'll take more than this/　to shake my resolve!
I will not tolerate such rudeness!
Ngh! Fairlion,/　please hang in there!
I must watch my opponent's/　movements more closely...!
A-at this rate, I'm toast... I mean,/　in danger!
Al-Van can read the Fairlion's movements...?!
Movements with both grace and ferocity...!
My life is not mine alone!
As one who leads the people,/　I cannot lose to you...!
We must pull the Floraga/　away from the Cross Gate...!
I-I'm going to be crushed like this!
I can't be crushed by the Crystal Dragoon...!
That Zovorg unit has moves I don't know...!
If the Fairlion takes concentrated fire...!
Ugh, I must put more distance/　between me and the Lamaris...!
Wh-What will I do if that thing/　shows up in my dreams...
Ugh, it's so revolting up close...
Y-you won't hit me next time!
Were you perhaps going easy on me?
I'm not one to freak out... I mean,/　to falter over something like this.
At this rate, I'll have Latune/　worried about me...!
Jua-Mu! That was merely a hit!
Gu-Landon, I have no intention of/　accepting your path of conquest!
The Floraga's power.../　If I'd taken that head-on...
I shall hold my own against that machine too!
They seem to have studied/　our side very carefully...!
I must keep a proper eye on the Lamaris Kaana...!
Brute force won't bring down the Fairlion!
It came right where I expected.
I can see/　your every move, you know.
Too bad! For you, that is.
It'll take more than that/　to hit me, you know?
See? Right where I thought you'd be!
I have no intention of/　going down in a place like this.
I can't let my precious machine/　get scratched, after all.
The Fairlion isn't/　so easily caught.
I can see it! ...Indeed I can.
Don't mess with the Fairlion... I mean,/　please do not underestimate it.
Get lost an' don't come ba-- I mean,/　please do come again.
You underestimate me too much, Jua-Mu!
I can read those moves too, Fu-Ruu!
Power alone can't light the people's future!
Your thinking is arrogance itself, Herluga!
I can't have my precious Fairlion/　being controlled!
I have no intention of accepting/　the ruin you bring!
I know how to fight Zovorg units!
I won't be beaten by a ghost!
The Kaana Type won't catch me!
I've shaken off the Ares Geist!
I evaded it, but.../　I mustn't let my guard down.
I didn't dodge that/　all by myself.
It's all thanks to Fairion and Latune.
Against something like that,/　even without Latune's support...!
I mustn't be hit by something like that...!
We must stop that attack at once!
My Guard is sturdier than it looks!
This is no ordinary dress, after all.
Serves you ri-- I mean, what a pity.
Firing that at me is a waste of effort.
Kindly see yourself out at once!
I've used up far too much...
Let me smash 'em once mo--/　I mean, here's another strike!
I'll just go ahead and back you up!
I'll just go ahead and join in, Latune!
Raidi may not need my help,/　but still...!
Raidi's brother,/　allow me to assist!
Arado, leave the rest to me!
Mai is doing her best. Then so will I!
Alchemie, leave the rest to me!
Fiona, leave the rest to me!
Ing, allow me to assist you!
Arieil, leave the rest to me!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Rim, allow me to assist you!
Lüne, leave the rest to me!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
I shall come to your aid!
I cannot simply look the other way!
Now it is my turn to protect you!
I wish to be of use to Raidi...!
Raidi's dear brother,/　please fall back!
Arado!/　Don't let them cut you to the bone!
Seolla, I shall take this one!
Time to smash... I mean,/　let's go all out!
More pounding... I mean, one more strike!
I mustn't let it swing me around!
With this hammer, I'll wallop...!/　I mean, I shall strike them!
I shall use the Shishioh Blade!
This Missile is super fast, you know!
Never mind if a bill arrives later!
I shall use my trump card!
Here I go!/　Free Electron Cannon!
I shall try it just like Latune does!
It isn't over yet, I assure you!
And that is the end of you!
Latune, we shall use/　the Royal Heart Breaker!
Princess, single mode for this one!
I leave the rest to you, Latune!
And that is the end of you!
